text:
Alex: Quick sync 4: I opened a docs PR for the v1->v2 migration/notice. PR #8241. Need final signoffs before we put banners live.
Mira: Link?
Alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8241
Sam: Notes from my skim: update all `generate()` snippets to the new `responses` pattern, call out embeddings dim change, and add compatibility shims.
Jordan: Also add a short section for Dedicated customers explaining model pinning + fallback behavior.
Alex: Drafted a model-pin example but left the date off. Using `@pinned` per Sam's suggestion.
Mira: For embeds: call out alias change from `embed-small` -> `embed-ada-2x`, and explicitly show vector dim change (1536 -> 1024). Add fallback example showing conversion logic clients should run.
Sam: I'll prepare cross-language snippet replacements for JS/Python/Go. Also adding a one-file shim for quick migrations (temporary).
Alex: Proposed Node shim in PR:

```js
// temporary compatibility shim
function generate(client, params) {
  return client.responses.create({ input: params.input, ...params });
}
```

Mira: Tag it clearly as 'temporary' and warn about differences in token accounting.
Jordan: We need a short token-accounting blurb. small changes after responses rename affect cost calculators. Add a numeric example for a 512-token prompt.
Sam: I'll run a repo grep to find leftover `generate(` calls and replace examples where safe.
Mira: Legal requested an audit note for Private deployments: mention that `model_id` will appear in audit logs after the model swap. I'll paste the approved wording into the PR.
Alex: Can someone add a Dedicated config snippet that demonstrates stable pinning and fallback?
Mira: Added:

```yaml
# Dedicated: pin a model bundle
inference:
  model: "embed-ada-2x@pinned"
  fallback: "embed-small"
```

Sam: One more: streaming example parity. Add a tiny playground snippet showing streaming responses and function-calling equivalence.
Alex: I can add that tomorrow AM.
Jordan: Plan for banners: soft-deprecation banner 3 business days after docs merge, then 30-day user-facing sunset. I'll draft the notice and coordinate with comms + trust.
Sam: CI reminder: include docs-smoke results in the PR body.
DocsBot: automated: docs-smoke queued.
Alex: Owners: Jordan = comms + announcement, Mira = Dedicated/Legal copy, Sam = SDK snippets and grep, Alex = migration table + embed callouts.
Mira: I fixed a broken crosslink `/guides/embed` -> `/guides/embeddings` in a follow-up commit.
Sam: I'll run the smoke locally in the morning and search/replace for `generate(` examples.
Alex: Merge window set for 08:30 PT tomorrow. If anyone finds blockers, comment on PR. Thank you. :thumbsup:
DocsBot: automated: PR #8241 updated; smoke status pending.
